name: ai-daily-news-agent
description: AI Daily News Agent - Social Edition. Fetches AI news from multiple sources and sends daily digests via Telegram/WhatsApp.

scripts.start: npm run build && node dist/index.js start
scripts.fetch-now: npm run build && node dist/index.js fetch-now
scripts.test: npm run build && node dist/index.js test
scripts.logs: cat data/logs/$(date +%Y-%m-%d).log 2>/dev/null || echo 'No logs for today'
